claim.description: Natural-language factual claim, e.g., "Apple's FY2024 revenue was $400 billion" or "Microsoft made about $100B in profit last year".

tolerance_pct.description: Max percent deviation still graded approximately_correct (0.5-50). Overrides the tolerance implied by the claim wording, set 1-2 for hallucination detection where any material error must be refuted. Default: implied by wording, capped at 5.
